reuse.why: The actions reuse category selection, sign conversion, batching and undo infrastructure, but the fixed-tag check reimplements existing tag parsing.

duplication.why: Budget eligibility remains centralized, but the inline #fixed regex duplicates tag-recognition logic from shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in budget/actions.ts and method registration follows the existing budget/app.ts layering.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk actions, supporting category metadata, registration and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: All bulk actions share the evolving eligibility policy, although maintaining a separate tag grammar creates avoidable ownership overhead.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: getBulkBudgetCategories uses an inline #fixed regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: getBulkBudgetCategories reshapes shared tag recognition into a dedicated regex for #fixed rather than reusing extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories retains centralized selection for every bulk action; includeHiddenCategories replaces includeHidden, and the new exclusions extend its common predicate without action-specific branches.
